replies.author: BendyNevis
replies.text:
GrapheneOS

TalkBack has bricked my phone

I've been using Graphene for 2 years

Pixel tablet and pixel 9 for daily use. Have also Graphene installed successfully on Pixel 5 and Pixel 7Pro, so quite familiar with the operating system

I installed graphene on a pixel 7 Pro a couple of days ago. The installation was quick, but trying to install apps has been near impossible

I put it down to server/weather problems

This phone ran Graphene without issues in the past, I only I reverted it to access a bank account that wasn't accessible on Graphene

I saw the comment about TalkBack on Bluesky and remembered that there had been a notification saying that there was an issue with it

I opened it in order to provide some feedback

Talkback has taken over the screen.

Touch and swipe are inoperable outside of the TalkBack app.

I am unable to switch off the phone via the power button

or access options via the power and volume controls

I'm hoping that I can regain control after the battery has drained and I switch it back on

replies.author: other8026
replies.text: BendyNevis Try holding down the power button for a long time to force a shutdown.

replies.author: int_32
replies.text:
BendyNevis This sounds like TalkBack’s navigation mode. It changes touch controls across the phone: tap once to select an item, then double-tap to activate it. Use two fingers to scroll.

Try holding both volume buttons together for a few seconds to turn TalkBack off, if that shortcut is enabled. Otherwise, use those gestures to go to Settings → Accessibility → TalkBack and turn off “Use TalkBack”.

Do double-taps and two-finger swipes work for you?

replies.author: Pocketstar
replies.text:
For people that lost control; I guess the best thing people can do it to connect a physical computer mouse through the OTG connection in order to gain control, that'll make navigation possible for people that are lost in Talkback.

However, for it to work at least a USB data connecton needs to be enabled in security settings.

It is best to prevent issues by following the Talkback tutorial in order to learn how it works, or watch a YouTube tutorial on the subject on a different device. Perhaps a nice video to make for Side Of Burritos or another GrapheneOS user? Then people that get stuck can be linked to the video.

I have sinds learned to control Talkback and have no problems with it; it feels like second nature even though I am not blind myself, it works splendid once you know how.

I need to be able to assist my girlfriend from time to time, that is why I had to learn.
